label: Greek downgrades
what: Fitch and S&P cut Greece (8 and 16 Dec 2009); first Greek widening after the October deficit revision

label: Greece asks for help
what: Eurostat revises Greece's 2009 deficit to 13.6% (22 Apr); Greece requests assistance (23 Apr); S&P cuts Greece to junk and Portugal two notches (27 Apr)

label: Greek loan, EFSF, SMP
what: Greek programme (2 May); EFSM/EFSF agreed and the ECB starts buying bonds (9-10 May)

label: Deauville
what: Franco-German agreement at Deauville (18 Oct; markets reacted on the 19th) that a permanent mechanism will involve private creditors; endorsed by the European Council (28-29 Oct)

label: Ireland's request
what: Ireland requests assistance (21 Nov); programme agreed (28 Nov); finance ministers' statement that private involvement applies only after mid-2013 (12 Nov)

label: PEC IV rejected
what: Parliament rejects the fourth austerity package (23 Mar); the government resigns; rating cuts; European Council agrees the ESM (24-25 Mar)

label: Request and ECB hike
what: Portugal requests assistance (6-7 Apr); the ECB raises its main rate to 1.25% (7 Apr)

label: Programme agreed
what: Memorandum agreed (3 May) and approved by the Eurogroup (16-17 May)

label: Junk, hike, summit
what: Moody's cuts Portugal to junk, citing the risk that private creditors would have to participate before further official lending (5 Jul); ECB raises its rate to 1.50% (7 Jul); euro summit lowers EFSF rates and adopts Greek private-sector involvement (21 Jul)

label: ECB cut
what: ECB cuts to 1.25% (3 Nov); Greek referendum episode

label: LTRO, cut
what: ECB cuts to 1.00% and announces three-year loans (8 Dec); first allotment (21 Dec)

label: Peak
what: S&P cuts nine euro sovereigns, Portugal to junk (13 Jan); Portugal's spread at its monthly peak

label: Greek bond exchange
what: Greek private-sector exchange completed (9 Mar); the Greek yield series switches to the new bonds

label: OMT announced
what: ECB announces it will consider outright purchases (2 Aug)
